tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. The violet can hangs upright in mid-air, beaded with cold condensation, its print square to camera, while a halved yuzu, two thin wheels and a spray of clear ice shards burst outward around it, frozen at a flash-sharp instant. The backdrop is a smooth saturated lime-yellow sweep. One hard strobe from the upper left with a white card fill on the right, every droplet on the can catching a pinpoint highlight. 100mm from exactly can height, the can filling the middle third of the frame, deep focus across the fruit.
